comparison.objective: Assemble three slotted boards into a partition on a marked line.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual stabilization, slot alignment, and downward interlocking insertion.
comparison.success_condition: Both crossings interlock within position, flushness, orientation, and one-second stillness tolerances.
comparison.reason: Tests multi-part alignment and slot insertion, not a locked rotary adjustment followed by measured cycling.
